ValidationRule.description: Vehicle ID is required when the Status is 'Closed' or 'Pending Closure' the associated Account is not a South American customer, and the Mode of Transportation is not 'Truck'.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( OR( Account.BillingCountry = "Brazil", Account.BillingCountry = "Paraguay" ) ), OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Closed"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Closure Pending") ), NOT( OR( ISPICKVAL(Type, "Master Data"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "EDI") ) ), NOT( AND( ISPICKVAL(PMC_SS_IssueReason__c, "MDM Verification"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Internal") ) ), NOT(ISPICKVAL(PMC_SS_MOT__c, "Truck")), ISBLANK(PMC_SS_VehicleId__c), RecordType.DeveloperName = "PMC_SS_CaseGeneral" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Vehicle ID is required to close your case.
